# 2.x to 3.x

:::caution[v3 release candidate, unreleased]

This is the reference for `@obolnetwork/obol-sdk@3.0.0-rc.12`, generated from its source and spec. Names and shapes may still change before 3.0.0, and it is not on npm `latest`. For the released SDK see the [2.x reference](../sdk/index.md).

:::

## What changes everywhere {#everywhere}

- **viem instead of ethers.** Pass viem clients; the ethers `Signer` / `Provider` are gone. `viem@^2.27.0` is a
  peer dependency.
- **Prepare, then send.** A write no longer sends a transaction itself. `prepare*` checks everything and returns a
  [`Prepared`](./reference/types/send.md#Prepared) (`kind`, `request`, `checks`, `preview`, `blockNumber`); `obol.send(prepared)` sends it, or your wallet
  layer sends `prepared.request`. `send` refuses a [`Prepared`](./reference/types/send.md#Prepared) whose `checks` hold a warning until its code is passed
  in `acknowledge` (see [From 3.0.0-rc.11 to rc.12](https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/MIGRATION.md#from-300-rc11-to-rc12)); 2.x had nothing like it.
- **Units.** ETH amounts are `bigint` wei everywhere (2.x mixed ETH strings, gwei and numbers). Shares are integer
  parts per million (`1_000_000` = 100%); [`splits.percent('33.3333')`](./reference/splits.md#percent) converts.
- **Errors.** One class, [`ObolError`](./reference/types/core.md#ObolError) ([`ObolApiError`](./reference/types/core.md#ObolApiError) for API answers), with a stable `code`; switch on it with
  `isObolError(error, code)`.

## Every 2.x method {#methods}

<div class="sdk-table">

| 2.x | 3.x |
|---|---|
| `client.hasAcceptedTerms()` | [`obol.terms.hasAccepted(address?)`](./reference/terms.md#hasAccepted) |
| `client.acceptObolLatestTermsAndConditions()` | [`obol.terms.accept({ ifNotAccepted? })`](./reference/terms.md#accept) |
| `client.createClusterDefinition(payload)` | [`obol.cluster.prepareDefinition(input)`](./reference/cluster.md#prepareDefinition) then [`obol.cluster.create(prepared)`](./reference/cluster.md#create) |
| `client.acceptClusterDefinition({ enr, version }, configHash)` | [`obol.cluster.accept({ configHash, enr, version? })`](./reference/cluster.md#accept) |
| `client.getClusterDefinition(configHash)` | [`obol.cluster.get(configHash)`](./reference/cluster.md#get) |
| `client.getClusterLock(configHash)` | [`obol.cluster.getLock({ configHash })`](./reference/cluster.md#getLock) |
| `client.getClusterLockByHash(lockHash)` | [`obol.cluster.getLock({ lockHash })`](./reference/cluster.md#getLock) |
| `client.getDepositData(lock, options)` / `depositDataFromLock` | [`obol.deposits.fromLock(lock, { amount?, validators? })`](./reference/deposits.md#fromLock). `amount` (wei) is required when the lock has deposit data for several amounts, as Charon's default locks do (1 ETH and 32 ETH): [`DEPOSIT_AMOUNT_REQUIRED`](./errors.md#DEPOSIT_AMOUNT_REQUIRED) otherwise |
| `validateClusterLock(lock)` | `await isValidLock(lock, options?)` (boolean; also [`cluster.isValidLock`](./reference/cluster.md#isValidLock), bound [`obol.cluster.isValidLock`](./reference/cluster.md#isValidLock)). **Not** a rename to `verifyLock`: see [Verifying locks on a server](https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/MIGRATION.md#verifying-locks-on-a-server) |
| `client.createObolRewardsSplit(...)` | [`obol.setup.prepareOvmWithSplits(obol.setup.rewardsSplit({ ... }))`](./reference/setup.md#prepareOvmWithSplits) |
| `client.createObolTotalSplit(...)` | [`obol.setup.prepareOvmWithSplits(obol.setup.totalSplit({ ... }))`](./reference/setup.md#prepareOvmWithSplits) |
| `client.splits.createValidatorManagerAndRewardsSplit(...)` | [`obol.setup.prepareOvmWithSplits(obol.setup.rewardsSplit({ ... }))`](./reference/setup.md#prepareOvmWithSplits) |
| `client.splits.createValidatorManagerAndTotalSplit(...)` | [`obol.setup.prepareOvmWithSplits(obol.setup.totalSplit({ ... }))`](./reference/setup.md#prepareOvmWithSplits) |
| `client.splits.requestWithdrawal(...)` | [`obol.ovm.prepareWithdraw({ ovm, requests, acknowledgeFullExit? })`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareWithdraw) |
| `client.splits.deposit(...)` | [`obol.deposits.prepareDeposit({ deposits, via: { ovm } })`](./reference/deposits.md#prepareDeposit). For a validator that already exists pass `kind: 'topUp'`; `kind: 'deposit'` (the default) throws [`DEPOSIT_VALIDATOR_EXISTS`](./errors.md#DEPOSIT_VALIDATOR_EXISTS), or [`DEPOSIT_CONFLICT`](./errors.md#DEPOSIT_CONFLICT) when its credentials are someone else's |
| `client.getOWRTranches(owr)` | [`obol.experimental.legacy.getOwrTranches(owr)`](./reference/experimental.md#legacy-getOwrTranches) (any client chain, Gnosis and Sepolia included, since rc.6) |
| `client.eoa.requestWithdrawal(...)` | [`obol.withdrawals.prepareEoaWithdraw({ pubkey, amount })`](./reference/withdrawals.md#prepareEoaWithdraw) |
| `client.eoa.deposit(...)` | [`obol.deposits.prepareDeposit({ deposits, via: { batch: true }, expectedWithdrawalAddress })`](./reference/deposits.md#prepareDeposit) |
| `client.incentives.getIncentivesByAddress(address)` | [`obol.incentives.get(address)`](./reference/incentives.md#get) |
| `client.incentives.isClaimed(contract, index)` | [`obol.incentives.isClaimed({ contractAddress, index })`](./reference/incentives.md#isClaimed) |
| `client.incentives.preflightClaim(address)` | [`obol.incentives.preflight(address)`](./reference/incentives.md#preflight) |
| `client.incentives.claimIncentives(address)` | [`obol.incentives.prepareClaim(address)`](./reference/incentives.md#prepareClaim) then `obol.send` |
| `client.exit.validateExitBlobs(clusterConfig, payload, beaconNodeApiUrl, existingBlob)` / `verifyPartialExitSignature` / `verifyExitPayloadSignature` | [`obol.exits.assertPartialExit({ cluster, payload, existing })`](./reference/exits.md#assertPartialExit). No beacon node URL: the genesis validators root comes from the SDK's chain table. A stored exit with **any** other epoch is [`EXIT_EPOCH_MISMATCH`](./errors.md#EXIT_EPOCH_MISMATCH) (2.x accepted a higher one); `details.direction` says which way, and the stored exit must be deleted before re-signing (see rc.12) |
| `client.exit.recombineExitBlobs(...)` | [`obol.exits.aggregate({ validator, exit, threshold })`](./reference/exits.md#aggregate) (threshold aggregation; 2.x summed the partials, which is not a valid exit signature) |
| `blsVerify(pubkey, message, signature)` (`Uint8Array`s) | [`exits.blsVerify(pubkey, message, signature, { bls? })`](./reference/exits.md#blsVerify) with `Hex` strings (`bytesToHex` from viem). Throws [`PAYLOAD_INVALID`](./errors.md#PAYLOAD_INVALID) on malformed input (not hex, wrong length) where 2.x returned `false`; a well-formed value that is not a valid point is still `false`. `bls` picks the backend (`await loadBlstBackend()` on a server; default pure JS) |
| `validateAddressSignature({ address, token, data, chainId })` | `await isValidTypedDataSignature({ address, signature: token, typedData: data, chainId, publicClients })`. A contract wallet (Safe) is checked only with a client for `chainId` (2.x used built-in RPCs); both the EIP-1271 magic `0x1626ba7e` and the legacy `isValidSignature(bytes, bytes)` → `0x20c13b0b` of Safes before 1.3.0 are accepted, as with 2.x's Safe protocol-kit (since rc.6). `data` may stay eth-sig-util's `TypedMessage` (since rc.6: a bytes `domain.salt` is converted to hex; rc.5 needed a cast). 2.x threw on a malformed `token`; v3 returns `false` |
| `validateEOASignature({ token, data, address })` | `await isValidTypedDataSignature({ address, signature: token, typedData: data })` (async; `false` instead of a throw for a malformed signature, as above) |
| `getWithdrawalRequestFee` / `resolveWithdrawalFee` | inside `prepareWithdraw` / `prepareEoaWithdraw` (`fee` input; [`FEE_OUT_OF_RANGE`](./errors.md#FEE_OUT_OF_RANGE)) |
| OWR / SplitMain creation | removed (reads of existing contracts stay under `experimental.legacy`) |

</div>

## Every other 2.x export {#exports}

<div class="sdk-table">

| 2.x | 3.x |
|---|---|
| `ENR` (`@chainsafe/enr`): `ENR.decodeTxt(enr)` to validate, `.publicKey` | [`cluster.isValidEnr(enr)`](./reference/cluster.md#isValidEnr) (boolean), `cluster.parseEnr(enr).publicKey` (compressed key as `0x`-prefixed hex; 2.x code that did `Buffer.from(publicKey).toString('hex')` got it without the prefix, so drop or add `0x` where it is compared or stored; [`PAYLOAD_INVALID`](./errors.md#PAYLOAD_INVALID) for a bad record). For other fields, import `@chainsafe/enr` yourself |
| `clusterLockHash(lock)` (obol-api `lock-definition-backfill.ts`) | [`cluster.computeLockHash(lock)`](./reference/cluster.md#computeLockHash). Decodes the lock first ([`PAYLOAD_INVALID`](./errors.md#PAYLOAD_INVALID) for a malformed one) and throws [`DEFINITION_INVALID`](./errors.md#DEFINITION_INVALID) (`version_unsupported`) for a version the SDK does not implement, v1.9.0 included |
| `verifyDepositData(pubkey, depositData, withdrawalAddress, forkVersion)` and the like | `await deposits.assertDepositData(deposits, { chainId, expectedWithdrawalAddress?, kind?, bls?, signal? })`: resolves or throws [`DEPOSIT_INVALID`](./errors.md#DEPOSIT_INVALID) with the failing `index` and `issue` (no boolean) |
| `clusterConfigOrDefinitionHash(definition, true)` / `(definition, false)` | [`cluster.computeConfigHash(definition)`](./reference/cluster.md#computeConfigHash) / [`cluster.computeDefinitionHash(definition)`](./reference/cluster.md#computeDefinitionHash). Both decode the definition first and throw [`PAYLOAD_INVALID`](./errors.md#PAYLOAD_INVALID) for a malformed one (map it to a 400); a mongoose document is accepted as it is |
| `signCreatorConfigHashPayload({ creator_config_hash }, chainId)` | [`cluster.creatorConfigHashTypedData(configHash, chainId)`](./reference/cluster.md#creatorConfigHashTypedData) (viem typed data: no `EIP712Domain` in `types`, same hash) |
| `signOperatorConfigHashPayload`, `signEnrPayload` | [`cluster.operatorConfigHashTypedData(configHash, chainId)`](./reference/cluster.md#operatorConfigHashTypedData), [`cluster.enrTypedData(enr, chainId)`](./reference/cluster.md#enrTypedData) |
| `validateAddressSignature`, `validateEOASignature` | `isValidTypedDataSignature` (see the method table) |
| `SPLITS_V2_SALT` | `splits.DEFAULT_SPLIT_SALT` (same value) |
| `PRINCIPAL_THRESHOLD` (`16`, ETH as a number) | `setup.DEFAULT_PRINCIPAL_THRESHOLD` (`16n * 10n ** 18n`, wei as a bigint); `MIN_` / `MAX_PRINCIPAL_THRESHOLD` next to it |
| `CHAIN_CONFIGURATION[chainId].BATCH_DEPOSIT_CONTRACT.address` (and the other contracts) | `getObolChain(chainId).contracts?.batchDeposit` (`CHAINS`, [`ChainContracts`](./reference/types/client.md#ChainContracts): `ovmFactory`, `warehouse`, `withdrawalRequest`, ...) |
| type [`ClusterValidator`](./reference/types/cluster.md#ClusterValidator) | `cluster.ClusterValidator` (same fields: `fee_recipient_address`, `withdrawal_address`) |
| type `ClaimableIncentives` (`operator_address`, `amount: string`, `merkle_proof`, ...) | `incentives.Incentives` (`operatorAddress`, `contractAddress`, `index`, `amount: bigint`, `merkleProof`), from [`obol.incentives.get`](./reference/incentives.md#get) |
| `Client` | `createObolClient` (see [Client](https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/MIGRATION.md#client)) |
| `ClusterLockValidationTimeoutError`, `ClusterLockValidationBusyError` | none (see [Errors](https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/MIGRATION.md#errors)) |

</div>

## Renamed in 3.0.0-rc.12 {#rc12-renames}

For code written against an earlier release candidate. No aliases are kept.

<div class="sdk-table">

| rc.11 | rc.12 | Also renamed |
|---|---|---|
| `ovm.verify(ovm)` | [`ovm.getProvenance(ovm, { requireChain? })`](./reference/ovm.md#getProvenance) | type `OvmVerification` → [`OvmProvenance`](./reference/types/ovm.md#OvmProvenance); new [`OvmProvenanceOptions`](./reference/types/ovm.md#OvmProvenanceOptions). It reads where a contract came from; it never was a verifier of untrusted input |
| `splits.prepareDistribution(input)` | [`splits.prepareDistributeAll(input)`](./reference/splits.md#prepareDistributeAll) | [`Prepared`](./reference/types/send.md#Prepared) kind `'distribution'` → `'distributeAll'`; types `DistributionPreview` → [`DistributeAllPreview`](./reference/types/splits.md#DistributeAllPreview), `DistributionInput` → [`DistributeAllInput`](./reference/types/splits.md#DistributeAllInput). It distributes the OVM, its splits and the recipients' Warehouse balances; [`ovm.prepareDistribute`](./reference/ovm.md#prepareDistribute) is the OVM alone |
| `splits.previewDistribution(input)` | [`splits.previewDistributeAll(input)`](./reference/splits.md#previewDistributeAll) |  |
| `setup.prepareCreateSplit(input)` | [`splits.prepareCreateSplit(input)`](./reference/splits.md#prepareCreateSplit) | The alias is removed; `setup` no longer re-exports [`CreateSplitInput`](./reference/types/splits.md#CreateSplitInput) / [`CreateSplitPreview`](./reference/types/splits.md#CreateSplitPreview) (they are in `splits`) |
| `deposits.verifyDepositData(deposits, options)` | [`deposits.assertDepositData(deposits, options)`](./reference/deposits.md#assertDepositData) | type `VerifyDepositDataOptions` → [`AssertDepositDataOptions`](./reference/types/deposits.md#AssertDepositDataOptions). It throws [`DEPOSIT_INVALID`](./errors.md#DEPOSIT_INVALID); it never returned a verdict |
| `exits.verifyPartialExit(input)` | [`exits.assertPartialExit(input)`](./reference/exits.md#assertPartialExit) | type `VerifyPartialExitInput` → [`AssertPartialExitInput`](./reference/types/exits.md#AssertPartialExitInput). It throws `EXIT_*` and returns the blobs to store |
| `verifyTypedDataSignature(args)` (also `cluster.verifyTypedDataSignature`) | `isValidTypedDataSignature(args)` | It returns a boolean, like `isValidLock` |

</div>

The full guide, with every breaking change between the release candidates: [MIGRATION.md](https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/MIGRATION.md).
